bullets.id: Demokrat memenangi DPR dan Senat AS dalam pemilu sela. Trading Economics mencatat emas melonjak sekitar 2,6% ke $4.035 pada Rabu, kenaikan harian terbesar sejak pertengahan Agustus, dan Investing.com mencatat spot di $4.132,36 (naik 1,8%) pada Kamis pukul 08.52 WIB. ADP mencatat 86.000 pekerjaan swasta pada Oktober, di atas perkiraan 67.000, tetapi tidak menghentikan reli.
bullets.en: Democrats won both the US House and Senate in the midterms. Trading Economics has gold jumping about 2.6% to $4,035 on Wednesday, its biggest daily gain since mid-August, and Investing.com has spot at $4,132.36 (up 1.8%) at 08:52 WIB on Thursday. ADP counted 86,000 private jobs in October, above the 67,000 forecast, but that did not stop the rally.

bullets.id: Indeks dolar turun ke sekitar 101,3 dan yield 10 tahun AS ke sekitar 4,85%. Trump meredam kemungkinan serangan baru ke Iran, dan Brent jatuh di bawah $100 untuk pertama kali sejak awal Oktober, kini sekitar $94. Namun CME FedWatch masih menunjukkan peluang 79% kenaikan bunga Desember. Emas sekitar 26,3% di bawah rekor $5.608,35 dan masih turun sekitar 0,7% dalam sebulan.
bullets.en: The dollar index fell to around 101.3 and the US 10-year yield to around 4.85%. Trump played down the chance of new strikes on Iran, and Brent fell below $100 for the first time since early October, now around $94. But CME FedWatch still shows a 79% chance of a December hike. Gold is about 26.3% below its $5,608.35 record and still down about 0.7% over the month.

bullets.id: Emas sudah menembus resistance Kitco di $4.068 dan level FX Leaders di $4.046 dan $4.082; area ini kini menjadi support pertama, lalu $3.992 dan $3.975. Hari ini rilis klaim pengangguran mingguan, lalu payroll Oktober Jumat dengan perkiraan 68.000 pekerjaan setelah 29.000 pada September.
bullets.en: Gold has broken Kitco’s resistance at $4,068 and FX Leaders’ levels at $4,046 and $4,082; that zone is now the first support, followed by $3,992 and $3,975. Weekly jobless claims are due today, then October payrolls on Friday, forecast at 68,000 jobs after 29,000 in September.

bullets.id: Antam 1 gram naik Rp20.000 ke Rp2.557.000 dan buyback naik Rp50.000 ke Rp2.357.000, sehingga spread menyempit ke Rp200.000 (sekitar 7,8%). Galeri24 naik Rp12.000 ke Rp2.479.000 (buyback Rp2.333.000) dan UBS naik Rp39.000 ke Rp2.535.000 (buyback Rp2.308.000). Secara struktural, FX Leaders mencatat bank sentral membeli 321 ton pada kuartal III dan kepemilikan ETF mencapai rekor 4.256 ton.
bullets.en: Antam’s 1-gram price rose Rp20,000 to Rp2,557,000 and buyback rose Rp50,000 to Rp2,357,000, narrowing the spread to Rp200,000 (about 7.8%). Galeri24 rose Rp12,000 to Rp2,479,000 (buyback Rp2,333,000) and UBS rose Rp39,000 to Rp2,535,000 (buyback Rp2,308,000). Structurally, FX Leaders notes central banks bought 321 tonnes in Q3 and ETF holdings hit a record 4,256 tonnes.
